findings.title: Consume recovery codes in the federated test provider and test their lifecycle
findings.body: The new recovery-code validator only checks whether the submitted code is in the original list; it never consumes it. Moreover, getCredentials() recreates a fresh recovery credential from that unchanged list on every call. Consequently the same code remains valid indefinitely, the login form always requests the first code, and the authenticator's allCodesUsed() path is never exercised. The added integration test performs only one login, so it passes despite this broken one-time-code lifecycle. Make the fixture persist consumption state and extend the test to verify replay rejection, progression to the next code, and regeneration after exhaustion.
